clue.text: Humble oneself to go down after study

indicators.note: after places the going-down piece behind the study piece

parts.note: to con is to study or learn by heart
to descend is to go down

explanation.surface: Advice to a proud person: humble yourself by going down after some study.
explanation.definitionFit: To stoop to a lower level in manner, often patronisingly, is to lower oneself or deign.

clue.text: Stick with one in a suit

definitions.meaning: a heavy stick or cudgel used as a weapon
one of the four suits in a pack of playing cards, so a single card of it

explanation.definitionFit: A cudgel is a heavy stick, and a card marked with the black trefoil belongs to one of the four suits.

clue.text: Close-fisted approach

definitions.meaning: an old-fashioned British word for stingy or mean
to come close to something, as a verb

explanation.definitionFit: Near is dated slang for stingy, and as a verb it means to draw closer.

clue.text: Company car?

definitions.meaning: someone who accompanies you, a partner at a social event
the Ford ... was a popular model of car, hence the question mark

explanation.definitionFit: A partner taken to a dance keeps you company, and Ford sold a long-running model under that name.

clue.text: Keeping one way green

definitions.note: used as a noun: an environmentalist

parts.note: conservation is the keeping or preserving of something
I is the Roman numeral for one
ST is the abbreviation for street, a way

explanation.surface: A description of a single route kept environmentally friendly.
explanation.definitionFit: An environmental campaigner is called a green, after the Green movement.

clue.text: Massaged, one hears, as required

indicators.note: one hears signals that the word is judged by how it sounds when spoken

parts.note: kneaded means massaged, as a masseur works muscles

explanation.surface: A masseur's work was exactly what the patient required.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that was wanted or necessary was called for.

clue.text: Fight in the ring perhaps, with sharp blows being returned

indicators.note: being returned tells us the blows are read in the opposite direction

parts.note: raps are sharp knocks or blows

explanation.surface: A boxing bout in which sharp blows are traded back and forth.
explanation.definitionFit: Boxers practise by sparring, exchanging light punches in the ring.

clue.text: Chaplain might need a book for church song

indicators.note: might suggests the chaplain's letters could be rearranged into something else

parts.note: NT is the New Testament, a book of the Bible

explanation.surface: A chaplain may need a hymnbook for singing in church.
explanation.walkthrough: 'might' signals the anagram: CHAPLAIN rearranged gives PLAINCHA, then NT (New Testament) follows.
explanation.definitionFit: Gregorian chant, unaccompanied monophonic singing, is the traditional liturgical music of the church.

clue.text: Uniform appearance of soldier with sex appeal at the end of the day

parts.note: a regular is a professional soldier of a standing army
it is old slang for sex appeal, as in the It girl

indicators.note: at the end of picks just the closing letter of the word day

explanation.surface: A soldier with sex appeal turns up uniformed at the close of the day.
explanation.definitionFit: Evenness or consistency of pattern is a sameness throughout.

clue.text: Did not stress how cafe sometimes appears

definitions.text: Did not stress how cafe sometimes appears

parts.words: Did not stress how cafe sometimes appears
parts.note: the French word café carries an acute accent, but in English it is often written without one, without the mark that stresses its final letter

explanation.surface: Someone casually wrote the word for a coffee shop without its mark.
explanation.definitionFit: A word printed without its diacritic, or a syllable given no stress, lacks emphasis.

clue.text: Loud hairstyle

definitions.meaning: a sudden loud noise or explosion
in American English, a fringe of hair cut straight across the forehead

explanation.definitionFit: An explosion makes a loud sudden noise, and Americans call a fringe by the same name.

clue.text: Server who is speechless?

parts.note: a small lift that carries dishes between floors serves food but cannot speak, read as a waiter who is mute

explanation.surface: A waiter who cannot speak.
explanation.definitionFit: A small goods lift for carrying food between kitchen and dining room serves without speaking.

clue.text: Jack being the first native of Australia

parts.note: a jack is a sailor, and AB (able seaman) is another
original means being the first of its kind

explanation.surface: A sailor called Jack was the first to land in Australia.
explanation.definitionFit: The indigenous inhabitants of Australia were its earliest people.

clue.text: Slow-moving snake

parts.note: a snake moves by creeping, so it can be called one that creeps; the term also means a slow climbing plant

explanation.surface: A sluggish serpent.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that creeps along slowly, like a snake gliding along the ground, is named for that action.

clue.text: Large number going down in the final

parts.note: C is the Roman numeral for a hundred, a large number
losing, as a team going down to defeat

explanation.surface: Many players going down to defeat in the cup final.
explanation.definitionFit: The concluding or last part of something comes at its end.

clue.text: Talked wildly about Georgia returning devastated

indicators.note: about means the wild-talking word goes around the other piece

parts.note: raved means talked wildly or incoherently

indicators.note: returning tells us the abbreviation for Georgia is read backwards

parts.note: GA is the postal abbreviation for the US state of Georgia

explanation.surface: Someone ranted about Georgia coming back in ruins.
explanation.walkthrough: 'returning' turns GA into AG, and 'about' puts RAVED around it.
explanation.definitionFit: Ravaged land has been laid waste, ruined by destruction.

clue.text: Open a French bar

parts.note: un is the French for a
a bolt is a bar used to fasten a door

explanation.surface: Opening a bar in France.
explanation.definitionFit: To draw back the fastening of a door is to open it.

clue.text: Little Derek ran round in the weedy rye-grass

indicators.note: in places the rearranged letters inside the short name

parts.note: Del is a short form of the name Derek

indicators.note: round suggests the word ran is turned about into a new order

explanation.surface: Derek, small as he is, ran circles in the weed-filled grass.
explanation.walkthrough: 'round' rearranges RAN into ARN, and 'in' places that inside DEL.
explanation.definitionFit: A weedy annual grass of the ryegrass genus that infests cornfields.

clue.text: Similarly flighty creatures

parts.note: flighty points at winged animals, and the phrase for people who share character is a proverb about alike birds flocking together

explanation.surface: Birds that all behave in the same flighty way.
explanation.definitionFit: The proverb says those alike in plumage flock together, so the phrase describes people of similar type.

clue.text: Articles about drink giving heart trouble

indicators.note: about means the two articles go around the drink

parts.note: AN and A are the two forms of the indefinite article
gin is an alcoholic drink

explanation.surface: Magazine articles about drinking give the reader heart problems.
explanation.definitionFit: A condition of chest pain caused by reduced blood flow to the heart muscle.

clue.text: A South American city so pronounced in song

definitions.note: used adjectivally: delivered in a melodious singing style

parts.note: Rio de Janeiro is a city in Brazil

explanation.surface: A Brazilian city name, pronounced in a sung way.
explanation.definitionFit: A musical direction for a melodious style, between recitative and aria, describes how a passage is sung.

clue.text: Apple used in the manufacture of cheese

definitions.meaning: a variety of dessert apple, also called reinette

definitions.text: used in the manufacture of cheese
definitions.meaning: curdled milk from a calf's stomach, used to set milk for cheese

explanation.definitionFit: The name covers both an old apple variety and the enzyme preparation that curdles milk in cheesemaking.

clue.text: Colour of the Red Sea when rough

indicators.note: when rough suggests the sea's letters are churned up into a new order

explanation.surface: What colour the Red Sea turns in stormy weather.
explanation.walkthrough: 'when rough' signals the anagram of REDSEA.
explanation.definitionFit: A greyish-green shade named after the mignonette plant.

clue.text: Union man on the newspaper staff had smartened up

parts.note: a bridegroom is the man in a marriage union
ED is short for editor, one of a newspaper's staff

explanation.surface: A trade unionist working at the paper had tidied himself up.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone neatly dressed and tidied has been made presentable.

clue.text: Some pretty NE England river

indicators.note: Some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A rather attractive river in the north-east of England.
explanation.definitionFit: The river flowing through Newcastle in north-east England.

clue.text: Third man was competent, it was reported

indicators.note: it was reported signals that the word is to be judged by how it sounds

parts.note: able means competent

explanation.surface: The third man in the case was said to be competent.
explanation.walkthrough: In Genesis, after Adam and Cain, Abel is the third man.
explanation.definitionFit: In the Bible, Adam's second son was the third male human, after his father and brother Cain.

clue.text: Ambassador gives bishop a German title

parts.note: HE stands for His Excellency, the style of an ambassador
RR is Right Reverend, the style of a bishop

explanation.surface: An ambassador hands a bishop a German honorific.
explanation.definitionFit: The German equivalent of Mister, used before a man's name.

clue.text: Prominent announcement on overthrow of island

parts.note: a notice is a public announcement

indicators.note: overthrow of means the island's name is turned upside down, which in a clue read across is backwards

parts.note: Elba is the Mediterranean island where Napoleon was exiled

explanation.surface: A notice proclaims the overthrow of an island ruler.
explanation.definitionFit: Something conspicuous or easily seen stands out.

clue.text: Put one's trust in Rex going to the city

parts.note: R stands for Rex, Latin for king
Ely is a cathedral city in Cambridgeshire, England

explanation.surface: Trusting in the king as he heads off to town.
explanation.definitionFit: To depend on someone is to have confidence in them.

clue.text: To be all for another sportsman

indicators.note: another suggests the clue words are made into a different arrangement

explanation.surface: Being all for another sportsman: a fan's loyalty.
explanation.definitionFit: A player of soccer or rugby is an athlete of a particular game.
